items.title: Brock Bowers: Coach optimistic regarding Week 12 availability
items.text:
Raiders head coach Klink Kubiak said after Sunday's 38-24 loss to the Broncos that he's optimistic Bowers (ankle/quadriceps) will be available to face the Raiders on Nov. 29, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Omarion Hampton: Productive again in Week 11 loss
items.text:
Hampton carried the ball 14 times for 89 yards and caught his only target for four yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.

items.title: Braelon Allen: Effective complement to Hall in Week 11
items.text:
Allen rushed 16 times for 75 yards while catching his lone target for nine yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.

items.title: Bryce Young: Tosses two TDs in win over Ravens
items.text:
Young completed 22 of 30 passes for 254 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 35-33 win over Baltimore.

items.title: Geno Smith: Tosses three TDs in Week 11 win
items.text:
Smith completed 17 of 21 passes for 176 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers. He also rushed once for four yards.

items.title: Kenny Gainwell: Records 59 total yards in loss
items.text:
Gainwell rushed four times for 16 yards and brought in four of five targets for 43 yards in the Buccaneers 31-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
